# clerk_application (Resource)

Manages a Clerk application via the Platform API. The Platform API is a beta feature that must be enabled by Clerk — contact Clerk support or visit your dashboard to request access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_application" "example" {
  name = "my-application"
}

# With all optional create-only fields
resource "clerk_application" "full_example" {
  name              = "my-full-application"
  domain            = "example.com"
  environment_types = ["development", "production"]
  template          = "next"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the application.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Custom domain for the application. Create-only; changing forces replacement.
- `environment_types` (List of String) Environment types to create (e.g. ["development", "production"]). Create-only; changing forces replacement.
- `proxy_path` (String) Proxy path for the application. Create-only; changing forces replacement.
- `template` (String) Application template slug. Create-only; changing forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the application.
- `instances` (Attributes List) List of instances (environments) created for this application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances))

<a id="nestedatt--instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instances`

Read-Only:

- `environment_type` (String) Environment type (e.g. development, production).
- `instance_id` (String) Unique identifier of the instance.
- `publishable_key` (String) Publishable key for this instance.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret key for this instance.
